notes: Versioned loaded-language lexicon for deterministic detection. Any add/remove/rename requires owner review plus tests/golden/CHANGELOG.md entry (golden-set class). Detection output is attached to the per-article surface form only; never aggregated into a score.

categories.attack_verb: Verb framing the subject as aggressor rather than reporter of fact
categories.hedge_attribution: Wording that distances or casts doubt on an attribution
categories.evaluative_adjective: Explicit judgment adjective/adverb presented inside news copy
categories.scare_label: Ideologically loaded label for a group or policy
categories.dramatizing_noun: Noun escalating severity beyond sourced fact
